jp: {voice:009B0C}あれが帝国の正規軍か。{n}レオンの辺境部隊を除けば、{n}間近で見るのは初めてだね。
en: So that's the Empire's regular army. Leaving out Leon's border unit, this is my first look at them up close.

jp: {voice:009C0C}整然とした隊列だ。{n}やはり賊まがいの連中とは違うな。
en: Those are tidy ranks. Nothing like that bandit trash, that's for sure.

jp: {voice:009D0C}見てみろ、ガーロット。{n}帝国一精強な鋼鉄騎団を率いる{n}バルドゥス将軍だ。
en: Look there, Garlot. That is General Baldus, who leads the Steel Knights, the mightiest force in the Empire.

jp: {voice:009E0C}あれが軍神バルドゥス……{n}名前は聞いた事があるけど、{n}見るのは初めてだ。
en: So that's Baldus, the War God... I've heard the name, but this is the first time I've seen him.

jp: {voice:009F0C}長い間、帝国の軍を支え{n}『軍神』と渾名される…{n}いわば軍の頂点に立つ男だ。
en: For many years he has held up the Empire's army. The War God... The man at the very top of the military.

jp: {voice:00A00C}でも本当にお爺ちゃんね。{n}騎馬隊の指揮なんかできるの？
en: But he really is an old grandpa, you know. Can he even command a cavalry unit?

jp: {voice:00A10C}戦場を駆け回って戦い続け、{n}叩き上げであの地位を得た男だ。{n}決して侮るな。
en: He fought his way up to that rank, one battlefield after another. Do not underestimate him.

jp: {voice:00A20C}…ヴェルマン方伯。{n}この演習は何か裏があると{n}思っていますか？
en: ...Margrave Velleman. Do you think there's something behind this exercise?

jp: {voice:00A30C}ああ、恐らくは貴族が持つ力を{n}計ろうというお考えであろう。
en: Yes. Most likely His Majesty means to gauge the strength the nobles hold.

jp: {voice:00A40C}我々が力を持ち過ぎる事を{n}陛下は警戒されているのだ。
en: His Majesty is wary of our growing too powerful.

jp: {voice:00A50C}過小な評価を受け、{n}ソルティエ帝の警戒心が{n}和らげばよいのだが…
en: If we were underrated, Emperor Soltier might let down his guard somewhat...

jp: {voice:00A60C}手を抜け、って事か？{n}それは相手の力量と戦い方次第だ。{n}今回は難しいぜ。
en: Hold back, huh? That depends on how strong they are and how they fight. Won't be easy this time.

jp: {voice:00A70C}…そうであろうな。{n}相手はあの軍神なのだから。
en: ...I suppose not. Your opponent is the War God, after all.

jp: {voice:00A80C}貴族の私兵が相手とは…{n}我が鋼鉄騎団の調練になるものか。
en: Up against nobles' private soldiers... This will be no drill at all for my Steel Knights.

jp: {voice:00A90C}これは陛下。{n}いかがなされましたか？
en: Your Majesty. What brings you here?

jp: {voice:00AA0C}バルドゥスよ。{n}貴族の私兵共をどう見る？
en: Baldus. What do you make of these nobles' private soldiers?

jp: {voice:00AB0C}はっきりと申し上げれば、{n}…寄せ集めでございますな。
en: To speak plainly, sire... A mere rabble.

jp: {voice:00AC0C}ヴェルマンの私兵はどうだ？{n}巷を騒がせるグラムブレイズだ。
en: And Velleman's private soldiers? Gram Blaze, the talk of the town.

jp: {voice:00AD0C}あの赤髪の若武者達とは、{n}一度剣を交えた事がございます。
en: I have crossed swords once with that red-haired young warrior and his men.

jp: {voice:00AE0C}そうだな。{n}一度お前を破った連中だ。
en: So you have. And they defeated you.

jp: {voice:00AF0C}あの時は、失礼ながら余興と存じ、{n}実力は出しておりません。
en: That day, begging your pardon, I took it for a diversion and did not show my true ability.

jp: {voice:00B00C}…あの赤髪の若武者が団長ですな。
en: ...That red-haired young warrior is their captain, then.

jp: {voice:00B10C}他に比べれば、{n}いくらかマシという程度でしょう。
en: Compared with the others, I would call them somewhat better. No more than that.

jp: {voice:00B20C}部隊の強弱は、実際に{n}ぶつかってみなければわからない。{n}違うか、軍神よ？
en: The strength of a force can't be known until you actually clash with it. Isn't that so, War God?

jp: {voice:00B30C}…御意にございます。
en: ...As you say, sire.

jp: {voice:00B40C}まあよい。{n}奴らの真の力を引き出し、計れ。{n}よいな？
en: Very well. Draw out their true strength and measure it. Understood?

jp: {voice:00B50C}仰せのままに。
en: As you command.

jp: {voice:00B60C}グラムブレイズ…{n}民衆の間でその名を馳せる、{n}義軍と評判の連中か。
en: Gram Blaze... Famed among the people, known as a righteous army.

jp: {voice:00B70C}治安維持や不正者の取り締まり…{n}本来ならば我々が負うべき戦いに{n}率先して身を投じていると聞く。
en: Keeping the peace, cracking down on wrongdoers... I hear they rush into battles that ought rightly to be ours.

jp: {voice:00B80C}それと知りながら、{n}こんな演習に召喚するとは……{n}陛下の真意が理解できぬ。
en: And His Majesty, knowing as much, summons them to an exercise like this... I cannot fathom his true intent.

jp: {voice:00B90C}陛下…、今回の演習、{n}本当に反乱分子を炙り出すのが{n}目的なのでございますか？
en: Your Majesty... Is the true purpose of this exercise to flush out rebel elements?

jp: {voice:00BA0C}それもある。もう１つは、{n}噂に聞くグラムブレイズの{n}実力を測る事だな。
en: That's part of it. The other part is to measure the ability of this Gram Blaze I keep hearing about.

jp: {voice:00BB0C}ヴェルマンもそうだが、{n}どうも奴らは近い将来、俺の前に{n}立ちはだかるような気がするのだ。
en: Velleman too, but somehow I have a feeling those people will stand in my way before long.

jp: {voice:00BC0C}陛下……
en: Your Majesty...

jp: {voice:00BD0C}よし、演習を開始せよ。{n}まずはヴェルマンの私兵からだ。
en: All right, begin the exercise. Velleman's private soldiers go first.

jp: {voice:00BE0C}俺達からか…！{n}ヴェルマン、さっきも言ったが、{n}手を抜くのは難しいと思う。
en: We're up first...! Velleman, like I said before, I don't think we can hold back.

jp: {voice:00BF0C}いいだろう、ガーロット。{n}全力でやれ。
en: Very well, Garlot. Do it with all your strength.

jp: {voice:00C00C}いいのか、ヴェルマン？
en: You sure, Velleman?

jp: {voice:00C10C}あの軍神が見ているのだ、{n}手を抜けば分かってしまうだろう。
en: The War God himself is watching. If you hold back, he will know it.

jp: {voice:00C20C}何より私は、{n}お前達の成長ぶりを見てみたい。
en: Above all, I want to see how much you've grown.

jp: {voice:00C30C}言ってくれるな。{n}なら見せてやるぜ、ヴェルマン！{n}ビビって腰抜かすなよ！
en: Big talk. Then watch this, Velleman! Don't wet yourself!

jp: {voice:00C40C}…いや、{n}やはり貴族の私兵ごときに{n}拙者が出る事は無いだろう。
en: ...No. For a noble's mere private soldiers, there is no need for me to take the field.

jp: {voice:00C50C}バルドゥス様……
en: Baldus-sama...

jp: {voice:00C60C}第一部隊、前に出るのだ。{n}拙者は後軍として控えておく。
en: First unit, advance. I shall hold back with the rear guard.

jp: {voice:00C70C}お主らだけで蹴散らしてみよ。{n}よいな？
en: Scatter them on your own. Understood?

jp: {voice:00C80C}なんだ、軍神は出てこないのか？
en: What, the War God's not coming out?

jp: {voice:00C90C}…こいつら、{n}本当に一貴族の私兵なのか？{n}相当な調練を積んでいるぞ。
en: ...Are these guys really one noble's private soldiers? They've had some serious training.

jp: {voice:00CA0C}やはり強いな。{n}一筋縄ではいかないぜ……
en: Yeah, they're strong. This won't be simple...

jp: {voice:00CB0C}バルドゥス様……{n}申し訳ありません、撤退します！
en: Baldus-sama... Forgive us, we are withdrawing!

jp: {voice:00CC0C}バカな！　拙者が手塩にかけて{n}鍛え上げた鋼鉄騎団が破られた？
en: Impossible! The Steel Knights I trained with my own hands, defeated?

jp: {voice:00CD0C}敗因は…、貴族の飼い犬と侮った{n}拙者の心の驕りか。
en: And the cause of defeat... The arrogance in my own heart, dismissing them as a noble's lapdogs.

jp: {voice:00CE0C}武人は、いかなる戦いであれ、{n}正面から武で応えるべきか。{n}…恥じるべき行為であった。
en: A warrior must answer any battle head-on, with arms... My conduct was shameful.

jp: {voice:00CF0C}しかし、なんと勇壮な私兵か…{n}…いや、軍勢だ。{n}武人の血を滾らせる、立派な軍だ。
en: But what valiant private soldiers... No, what an army. A fine army, one that sets a warrior's blood boiling.

jp: {voice:00D00C}なんだ？{n}何をブツブツと…
en: What? What are you muttering about...

jp: {voice:00D10C}赤髪の青年よッ②{n}拙者はバルドゥスと申す！{n}名をお聞かせ願いたい。
en: Red-haired youth!! I am called Baldus! I would ask your name!

jp: {voice:00D20C}グラムブレイズ団長、{n}ガーロット。
en: Captain of Gram Blaze. Garlot.

jp: {voice:00D30C}ガーロット、よき名！{n}いざ、勝負である！
en: Garlot, a fine name! Now, have at you!

jp: {voice:00D40C}熱いぜ、軍神。{n}受けて立とうじゃないか！
en: You're fired up, War God. All right, I'll take you on!

jp: 整地された形跡がある…{n}何かの敷地だったのか？
en: Looks like the ground's been leveled... Was this some kind of compound?

jp: これは、囚人を逃さないために{n}取り付けておく足枷か…{n}じゃあ、ここってひょっとして…
en: This is a shackle, the kind they put on prisoners so they can't escape... So then, could this place be...

jp: 何か建物でもあったのかな？{n}あれこれ落ちてるけど…
en: Maybe there was a building here? There's all kinds of stuff lying around...

jp: …足枷だわ。{n}こんなの付けられたら{n}逃げられないわよ…
en: ...It's a leg shackle. If they put this on you, there's no way you're getting away...

jp: 地図によると、ここには昔{n}罪人の収容所があったみたいだね。
en: According to the map, there used to be a prison camp here.

jp: この足枷は当時の名残りかな？
en: I suppose this shackle is a relic of those days?

jp: 物々しい雰囲気がするな…{n}この土地、何かがおかしい？
en: There's an ominous feel to this... Is something wrong with this land?

jp: 鉄球付きの足枷か…{n}収容所でもあったのかな。
en: A leg shackle with an iron ball... There must have been a prison camp here.

jp: なんでしょう？{n}気持ちがざわざわします…
en: What is this? I feel uneasy...

jp: 足枷、ですか…{n}こんなの付けられたら{n}身動き取れませんね。
en: A leg shackle, is it... If I were made to wear this, I could not move at all.

jp: なんだ？{n}デカイ鉄球が落ちてるぞ…
en: What is this? There is a big iron ball lying here...

jp: ああ、囚人に付ける足枷か。{n}…バイフーの足には合わないな。{n}じゃあ、もし捕まっても安心だ。
en: Ah, a shackle for prisoners. ...It does not fit Byff's foot. So if Byff gets caught, no worry.

jp: 何か落ちているわね…
en: Something's lying here...

jp: あら、足枷じゃない。{n}こんなの付けられたら{n}とても逃げられないわね。
en: Well, if it isn't a leg shackle. If they put this on you, you'd never get away.

jp: …私がもらっておきましょ。
en: ...I'll just take it for myself.

jp: おや？　なんだろう、{n}デカい鉄の球が落ちてるな。
en: Huh? What's this? There's a big iron ball lying here.

jp: うわ、足枷か。{n}あまりお世話になりたくないね…
en: Yikes, it's a shackle. Not something I wanna get acquainted with...

jp: ウィーック…{n}んん？　なんだ、これ。
en: *hic* Ooh... Mm? What's this now.

jp: 足枷かぁ。{n}まあ、足がないあっしには{n}縁のないアイテムね。ヒック…
en: A shackle, huh. Well, no feet on me, so it's nothin' to do with me, y'hear. *hic*

jp: …なに、この感覚？{n}気持ちがざらつくわ…
en: ...What is this feeling? It's making Pamela-sama all prickly...

jp: これ、足枷じゃない。{n}という事は、まさかココって{n}刑務所か何か？
en: This is a shackle! Which means... Don't tell me this place was a prison or something?

jp: つまりこのあたりには、{n}処刑された人間の魂が{n}うろついてる、ってわけだわね…
en: So what you're saying is, the souls of people who got executed are wandering around here...

jp: おや？{n}何か落ちているようですが…
en: Oh? Something seems to be lying here...

jp: 足枷ですか。これを付けられると、{n}機動力は激減するでしょうね。{n}フフ…
en: A leg shackle, I see. Wearing one would drastically reduce one's mobility. Hehe...

jp: あらあら、一体なんでしょう？{n}身体がゾクゾクしてきましたわ…
en: Oh my, whatever could it be? I have come over all a-shiver...

jp: 鉄球付きの足枷ですわね！{n}…あーんなことや、こーんなこと、{n}色々と使えそうですわね♪
en: A shackle with an iron ball! ...Oh, all the naughty things one could do with this♪

jp: んんっ？{n}なんだ、身体にブルブルと{n}震えが来たぜ…
en: Hmm? What's this? I've got the shakes all of a sudden...

jp: お、足枷じゃんか。{n}これを身につければ{n}足のトレーニングができるな！
en: Hey, a leg shackle. If I strap this on, I can train my legs!

jp: …ここいらには、{n}囚人の施設でもあったのか？
en: ...Was there some kind of prison around here?

jp: 手錠に、足枷…{n}捕縛用の品物が多く落ちているな。
en: Handcuffs. Leg shackles... Many restraints lying about.

jp: ん？{n}何か布が落ちてるな…
en: Hm? There's some cloth lying here...

jp: …って、ただの布か。{n}だが、奇妙なくらい{n}おぞましい気配を感じるな…
en: ...It's just cloth. But it gives me a weirdly nasty feeling...

jp: あら、何か落ちているわ…
en: Oh, something's lying here...

jp: …何の変哲もない布だけど、{n}どうしてだろう。{n}手にしていると不安になるわ。
en: ...It's a totally ordinary piece of cloth, but I don't know why, holding it makes me nervous.

jp: おや？　何か落ちているね。
en: Oh? Something's lying here.

jp: ただの布みたいだけど…{n}何かの役に立つかな？
en: It looks like just a piece of cloth... I wonder if it'll come in handy?

jp: 何かしら、{n}布が落ちているけど。
en: What's this, I wonder? There's some cloth here.

jp: ただの布…？{n}なんでだろう、そうは見えないな。
en: Just cloth...? I don't know why, but it doesn't seem like it.

jp: あら？{n}そこに落ちているのは…
en: Oh? What is that lying there...

jp: 布、ですね。{n}風で飛ばされたのでしょうか？
en: Cloth, it would seem. Perhaps the wind carried it here?

jp: ん？　なんか落ちてるぞ。
en: Hm? Something is lying here.

jp: 布だ。{n}何に使うのか、わからぬのぅ。{n}なーんつって。
en: Cloth. What is it for? Byff has not the cloth-est idea. Ha, just kidding.

jp: ん？{n}何かしら、この布は。
en: Hm? What's this cloth?

jp: …ははぁ、さては囚人を{n}処刑するときに使う{n}目隠しの布ね。
en: ...Aha, it must be the blindfold they used when executing prisoners.

jp: …もらっておきましょうか。
en: ...I'll just take it, shall I.

jp: ん？　なんだ、アレ？
en: Huh? What's that?

jp: …なんだ、ただの布か。{n}宝の地図か何かだと思ったのに、{n}残念だぜ、まったく。
en: ...Oh, it's just cloth. I thought it was a treasure map or something. What a letdown.

jp: おや？{n}なんか落ちてるじゃない…{n}ヒック。
en: Well now? Somethin' lyin' here... *hic*

jp: 布、かしら…{n}ただの布にしか見えないけど。{n}ヒック！
en: Cloth, is it... Looks like plain old cloth to me. *hic*!

jp: なに？　なに？{n}怖気がするんだわさ。
en: What? What? Pamela-sama's getting the chills, y'know.

jp: この布には強烈な残留思念が{n}染み付いているんだわさ…
en: Intense lingering thoughts have soaked into this cloth, y'know...

jp: ほう、これは…{n}受刑者の目を塞ぐための布ですね。
en: Oh, what's this... A cloth for covering the eyes of the condemned.

jp: 私には不要なものですよ。{n}既に目が隠れていますからね。{n}フフフ…
en: I have no need of such a thing. My eyes are already covered, you see. Hehehe...

jp: おやぁ？{n}何か布が転がってきましたね。
en: Oh my? Some cloth has rolled up to me.

jp: 目を塞ぐための布ですね。{n}丈夫で、長さもちょうどいい…{n}逸品だわ。
en: A cloth for covering the eyes. Sturdy, and just the right length... A fine piece of work.

jp: おっ？　なんだぁ？{n}布が転がってきたぜ。
en: Huh? What's this? Some cloth's rolled up here.

jp: 何に使う布なのかねぇ？{n}オレには想像もつかないぜ。
en: What's this stuff for, anyway? Beats me.

jp: …む。{n}何か、転がってきたぞ。
en: ...Hm. Something has rolled over here.

jp: 布だな。{n}…教団が拷問に使った{n}目隠し用のものと似ている。
en: Cloth. ...Similar to the blindfolds the Order used for torture.

jp: グラムブレイズ
en: Gram Blaze

jp: バルドゥス鋼鉄騎兵（本隊）
en: Baldus Steel (Main)

jp: バルドゥス鋼鉄騎団第一勢力
en: Baldus Steel 1st Force

jp: {voice:00D50C}これからが本番だな。{n}ラピス…、お前はどう見る？
en: Now the real show begins. Lapis... What do you make of it?

jp: {voice:00D60C}…経験でバルドゥスが勝ります。
en: ...In experience, Baldus has the advantage.

jp: {voice:00D70C}集団戦闘は、用兵の優劣が{n}最も結果に表れると存じます。
en: In large-scale combat, I believe the difference in generalship shows most clearly in the result.

jp: {voice:00D80C}今のグラムブレイズには、{n}そのような思想が無いと見ます。
en: I do not see that kind of thinking in Gram Blaze as it stands.

jp: {voice:00D90C}フム…
en: Hmm...

jp: {voice:00DA0C}確かに理論的に考察すれば、{n}ラピスの指摘は正しい。
en: Considered logically, your point is indeed correct, Lapis.

jp: {voice:00DB0C}だが、あの赤髪……{n}なにかやりそうな気配を感じる。
en: But that red-haired one... I sense he may be up to something.

jp: {voice:00DC0C}気迫に満ちた攻撃だ。{n}なかなかやるな、ガーロット！
en: An attack brimming with spirit. You're quite good, Garlot!

jp: {voice:00DD0C}眠っていた軍人の血が、{n}熱くなってくるのを感じるぞ②
en: I can feel a soldier's sleeping blood growing hot!!

jp: {voice:00DE0C}だが鋼鉄騎団の真髄はこれからだ。{n}このバルドゥス、{n}たやすく敗れはせんぞ…！
en: But the true essence of the Steel Knights begins now. I, Baldus, shall not fall so easily...!

jp: {voice:00DF0C}攻撃も防御も見事なものだ！{n}第一部隊が敗れる訳だ……
en: Splendid in attack and defense alike! No wonder my first unit lost...

jp: {voice:00E00C}このような連中が在野とはな。
en: To think men such as these were out among the common folk.

jp: {voice:00E10C}まさか、陛下は知っていたのか？{n}それで拙者にぶつけたのか③
en: Could it be that His Majesty knew? Is that why he set them against me!?

jp: {voice:00E20C}お主の武、しかと見届けたぞ。{n}若く、素晴らしい力だ…！
en: I have seen your prowess with my own eyes. Young, and a splendid power...!

jp: {voice:00E30C}貴族の私兵風情と侮ったが、{n}拙者の誤りであった。{n}武人として敬意を表する。
en: I dismissed you as a noble's private soldiers, and I was mistaken. As a warrior, I pay you my respects.

jp: {voice:00E40C}アンタもな。{n}歳を感じさせない動きだったぜ。
en: Same to you. You sure don't move like an old man.

jp: {voice:00E50C}願わくばその力、{n}誤った道のために使わぬ事を……
en: I only pray you will not use that power for the wrong path...

jp: {voice:00E60C}もちろんだ。{n}この力は民の為に！
en: Of course not. This power's for the people!

jp: {voice:00E70C}民……、うむ。{n}その意気やよし。
en: The people... Yes. A fine spirit.

jp: {voice:00E80C}それまでだ！　この演習は{n}グラムブレイズの勝利とする！
en: Enough! Gram Blaze is the victor of this exercise!

jp: {voice:00E90C}よしっ！
en: Yes!

jp: {voice:00EA0C}やったな、メデューテ！
en: We did it, Medoute!

jp: {voice:00EB0C}ああ、そうだな……
en: Yes, we did...

jp: {voice:00EC0C}（演習とはいえ、{n}　軍神バルドゥスを破った…）
en: (Exercise or not, they beat Baldus, the War God...)

jp: {voice:00ED0C}（グラムブレイズに対する{n}　世間の評価は変わるな。{n}　ただの私兵ではなくなる…）
en: (The world will see Gram Blaze differently now. They won't be mere private soldiers anymore...)

jp: {voice:00EE0C}ん？　どうした、メデューテ。{n}ハッキリ言ってくれよ、{n}らしくないぜ。
en: Hm? What's up, Medoute? Just say it, will you? This isn't like you.

jp: {voice:00EF0C}いや、{n}ちょっと言いづらい事なんだが……
en: No, it's just a little hard to say...

jp: {voice:00F00C}知ってると思うけど、{n}あたしは元々、旅の空の人間でさ。
en: As you know, I've always been a drifter, living under open skies.

jp: {voice:00F10C}あたしは、{n}君達の戦いに興味を持った。{n}そして今まで、一緒に戦ってきた。
en: Your fight caught my interest. And I've fought beside you all this time.

jp: {voice:00F20C}つい長居をしてしまった。{n}居心地が良すぎたからね……{n}だけど、そろそろ潮時みたい。
en: I ended up staying too long. It was too comfortable here... But it looks like it's about time I moved on.

jp: {voice:00F30C}……私兵団を抜けたい。{n}そういう事か？
en: ...You want to leave the private army. Is that it?

jp: {voice:00F40C}今すぐに、というわけじゃない。
en: Not right this minute.

jp: {voice:00F50C}ただあたしは…、色々な責任から{n}逃げて、旅を始めた人間なの。
en: It's just... I'm someone who started traveling to run away from a lot of responsibilities.

jp: {voice:00F60C}その放棄した責任を思うと、{n}新しい責任を背負う事に{n}抵抗を覚えるのよ。
en: When I think of the ones I abandoned, I balk at taking on new ones.

jp: {voice:00F70C}……そうか、わかった。{n}その時が来たら、言ってくれ。
en: ...Okay, got it. When the time comes, tell me.

jp: {voice:00F80C}ありがとう……
en: Thank you...

jp: {voice:00F90C}…あと、シスキアにはしばらく{n}黙っておいてくれないか。
en: ...One more thing. Could you keep this from Siskier for a while?

jp: {voice:00FA0C}あの子に引き留められると、{n}その、決心が鈍りそうでさ。{n}シスキア、カワイイだろ。
en: If that girl begged me to stay, well, I might lose my nerve. Siskier's a sweet kid, isn't she.

jp: {voice:00FB0C}はははっ、そうか。{n}わかったよ、メデューテ。
en: Hahaha, yeah. All right, Medoute.

jp: {voice:00FC0C}陛下、面目ございませんでした…
en: Your Majesty, I am disgraced...

jp: {voice:00FD0C}構わん、過ぎた事だ。{n}それよりグラムブレイズだ。{n}あれはどうだ？
en: Never mind, it's over and done with. More to the point, Gram Blaze. What of them?

jp: {voice:00FE0C}…まず個々の能力が極めて高く、{n}正規軍と同等かそれ以上の鍛錬が{n}施されております。
en: ...First, each one's ability is extremely high, with training equal to the regular army or better.

jp: {voice:00FF0C}赤髪は？
en: And the redhead?

jp: {voice:00000D}ガーロットでございますな。{n}あの男は勇壮な騎士です。
en: Garlot, sire. That man is a valiant knight.

jp: {voice:00010D}また、常に先頭で戦うため、{n}兵は勇気付けられ、力を出します。
en: And since he always fights at the very front, his soldiers take courage and give their all.

jp: {voice:00020D}ふむ…{n}実戦では、勝てるか？
en: Hmm... Could you beat him in a real battle?

jp: {voice:00030D}状況によりますな。{n}ただ、鋼鉄騎団のみの編制での{n}力押しは難しいでしょう。
en: That would depend on the situation. However, brute force from the Steel Knights alone would be difficult.

jp: {voice:00040D}もし倒せとおっしゃるならば、{n}圧倒的な戦力で叩き潰すべきです。
en: Should you command me to destroy them, they must be crushed by overwhelming force.

jp: {voice:00050D}なるほど…、{n}もうよい、下がれ。
en: I see... That's enough. You may go.

jp: {voice:00060D}陛下、恐れながら。{n}反乱を企てているのはまさか……
en: Your Majesty, forgive me. Those plotting rebellion surely aren't...

jp: {voice:00070D}バルドゥスよ。{n}陛下は下がれとおっしゃったのだ。
en: Baldus. His Majesty told you to go.

jp: {voice:00080D}ハッ、御意に。
en: Yes, sire, as you command.

jp: {voice:00090D}軍神の名も地に落ちましたね。{n}鋼鉄騎団の精鋭を率いながらも{n}敗れるとは……
en: The name of the War God has fallen to the dust. To lose even with the elite of the Steel Knights...

jp: {voice:000A0D}しかし、あれも言っていただろう。{n}今回は騎兵のみの編制であった。
en: But as he said himself, this time his force was cavalry alone.

jp: {voice:000B0D}それに気付けば、{n}破る事は大して難しくない。
en: Once you notice that, beating such a force isn't very hard.

jp: {voice:000C0D}（しかしあの赤髪、何者だ？{n}　まだ力を隠している。{n}　そう思えてならないが…）
en: (But that redhead, what is he? He's still hiding his power. I can't shake that feeling...)

jp: {voice:000D0D}ラピス、ヴェルマンの周囲を探れ。{n}秘密裏にな。{n}必ず何かが出てくるはずだ。
en: Lapis, look into Velleman's circle. In secret. Something is bound to turn up.

jp: {voice:000E0D}それを以て聴聞会を開き、{n}ヴェルマンを帝都に召喚するのだ。
en: We'll use it to hold a hearing and summon Velleman to the capital.

jp: {voice:000F0D}…なるほど。{n}ヴェルマンとグラムブレイズを{n}引き離すのですね。
en: ...I see. So we separate Velleman from Gram Blaze.

jp: {voice:00100D}いや、共に上洛させろ。{n}しばらく帝都で貴奴らを飼い、{n}様子を見る事にする。
en: No, have them come to the capital together. I'll keep them on a leash there a while and watch them.

jp: {voice:00110D}……仰せのままに。
en: ...As you command.

jp: {voice:00120D}あの赤髪の秘めたる力は、{n}俺しか感じていないようだな…
en: It seems I'm the only one who senses that redhead's hidden power...

jp: {voice:00130D}さて、どう動くヴェルマン。{n}そして赤髪よ…
en: Now then, what will you do, Velleman? And you, redhead...
